notes.subject: כנדגלות
notes.rationale: 'Like the bannered ones' — companies with banners (armies) vs. constellation/aligned hosts; rendered 'taamasiyɛn bolibagaw' (banner-raisers), literal shape kept.

notes.subject: אימה
notes.rationale: Literally 'frightful/awesome'; rendered 'i bɛ siran bila' (you inspire fear), awe rather than terror.

notes.subject: to the woman
notes.rationale: The beloved speaks praise directly to his bride, opening with 'you'.

notes.subject: כנדגלות
notes.rationale: Nidgalot appears only here in the Tanakh.

translation: I tɔgɔce, ne kanuya-muso, i n'a fɔ Tirtsa (Tirtsa) ye; i ka diɲɛ i n'a fɔ Yerushalayim (Jerusalɛmu) ye; i bɛ siran bila i n'a fɔ taamasiyɛn bolibagaw ye.

tokens.gloss: i n'a fɔ taamasiyɛn bolibagaw ye
